title: SDR Daily Scratchpad - Lucas Holt - 2026-03-04
content:
Goals for today:
- Hit 60 dials (primary) / 30 connects (stretch)
- Book 3 qualified discovery meetings
- Follow up on 5 warm leads from last week

Morning plan (8:30-10:30)
- Prospecting block: email sequences + LinkedIn touches for cc0-cc10 list
- Call blitz: focus on EAST timezone companies (high-priority list below)
- Quick sync with Maya at 10:45 (prep for Tue AE handoff)

Call list (priority order)
1) BrightMetrics - Charlotte R. (VP Ops) - 10:00 AM EST - previous convo: interested in cost/perf comparisons for hosted vs dedicated. Use case: high-volume ticket summary. Next step: book 30-min demo with AE. Notes: follow up with specific latency numbers + customer case study (LogiCorp). SFDC: 006-BR-112
2) Meridian HealthTech - Sanjay Patel (CTO) - 11:15 AM EST - cold, engaged on email. Pain: on-prem inference + HIPAA. Ask: current infra + expected TPS. Next: send private deployment ebook + request discovery. SFDC: 006-ME-289
3) Nova Retail - Emily Zhang (Head of ML) - 2:00 PM EST - demo scheduled last month fizzled. Reframe ask: reduce token costs and faster rerank throughput. Offer: benchmark summary. Next: confirm availability for Wed. SFDC: 006-NV-074
4) AtlasEd - Marco Ruiz (VP Product) - 3:30 PM EST - warm lead, awaiting pricing. Action: send tailored pricing matrix and open time for call. SFDC: 006-AT-510
5) CoreLegal - Olivia Chen (Head of Ops) - 4:15 PM EST - compliance question: KMS/HSM integration. Next: loop in SE & Security PM (Maya). SFDC: 006-CL-912

Follow-ups / email snippets (copy + paste templates):
- Quick follow-up (after no reply):
  Subject: Quick follow-up on Redwood inference trial
  Body: Hi {first}, circling back on my note about reducing inference costs while preserving quality. Happy to share a short benchmark (2 slides) that compares hosted vs dedicated for your workload. 15 min this week?

- HIPAA/Private interest reply:
  Subject: Private deployment options + HIPAA
  Body: Hi {first}, we have a private VPC/on-prem option with KMS/HSM + audit logging. Happy to set up a short call with our security PM to walk through compliance controls. When works?

Pipeline notes / quick context:
- BrightMetrics: strong potential ARR $120-180k/year if they commit to dedicated. Main blocker: procurement timeline (Q2).
- Meridian HealthTech: high-touch enterprise, requires SOC2 + HIPAA certs - put on AE radar.
- Nova Retail: price sensitivity; show Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce unit costs.
- AtlasEd: trial ended, needs pricing clarity - likely SMB mid-market motion.
- CoreLegal: high compliance bar, needs written architecture and KMS details.

Tasks / TO-DO (priority order):
- [ ] Send BrightMetrics benchmark + book demo (by EOD)
- [ ] Email Meridian HealthTech the private deployment overview + schedule security call (cc Maya)
- [ ] Pull Nova Retail benchmark screenshots from last demo folder and attach to email
- [ ] Create pricing matrix draft for AtlasEd (use template: Confluence sd-pricing-matrix)
- [ ] Draft architecture note for CoreLegal and request Security PM review
- [ ] Update SFDC stages for 5 accounts above

Notes for AE handoff (if meetings booked):
- Always include cost/latency tradeoffs + suggested rollout (hosted -> dedicated -> private)
- Attach customer references for similar use cases (ex: LogiCorp for retail, MediSys for health)

Evening wrap (capture outcomes) - fill after calls:
- BrightMetrics outcome: ___
- Meridian outcome: ___
- Nova outcome: ___
- AtlasEd outcome: ___
- CoreLegal outcome: ___

Blocked / help needed:
- Need updated HIPAA one-pager from security (Maya)
- Pricing template: need latest numbers for dedicated (product team PRD link?)

Random notes / brain dump:
- Consider pushing a follow-up sequence that highlights "cost saved per 1M tokens" with three short customer examples
- Test A/B subject lines for Meridian email: "Private deployment + HIPAA" vs "HIPAA controls for LLMs"

Time log (start times):
- 08:30 prospecting / sequence edits
- 09:05 call block 1
- 10:45 sync w/ Maya
- 11:00 call with BrightMetrics prep

References / links:
- Confluence: sd-quick-templates (email templates + pricing matrix)
- Slack: #sdr-team for quick asks

End of scratchpad.
